t: 火灾摧毁了弗吉尼亚州的詹姆斯敦.
dz: 火灾摧毁了弗吉尼亚州的詹姆斯敦.

t: 埃塞俄比亚皇帝苏森约斯一世在埃贝纳特惊动了一支奥罗莫军队;据报道他的军队以他400人的代价杀死…
te: Emperor Susenyos I of Ethiopia surprises an Oromo army at Ebenat; his army reportedly kills 12,000 Oromo at the cost of…
dz: 埃塞俄比亚皇帝苏森约斯一世在埃贝纳特惊动了一支奥罗莫军队;据报道他的军队以他400人的代价杀死了12,000名奥罗莫.
de: Emperor Susenyos I of Ethiopia surprises an Oromo army at Ebenat; his army reportedly kills 12,000 Oromo at the cost of 400 of his men.

t: 苏森约斯被正式加冕为埃塞俄比亚皇帝.
te: Susenyos is formally crowned Emperor of Ethiopia.
dz: 苏森约斯被正式加冕为埃塞俄比亚皇帝.
de: Susenyos is formally crowned Emperor of Ethiopia.

t: 在爱尔兰,奥多赫蒂的"反叛"由"德瑞之火"发起.
te: In Ireland, O'Doherty's Rebellion is launched by the Burning of Derry.
dz: 在爱尔兰,奥多赫蒂的"反叛"由"德瑞之火"发起.
de: In Ireland, O'Doherty's Rebellion is launched by the Burning of Derry.

t: 西洛地安希尔德斯通的苏格兰新国有化银矿由贝维斯·布尔默重新开业.
te: A newly nationalized silver mine in Scotland at Hilderston, West Lothian is re-opened by Bevis Bulmer.
dz: 西洛地安希尔德斯通的苏格兰新国有化银矿由贝维斯·布尔默重新开业.
de: A newly nationalized silver mine in Scotland at Hilderston, West Lothian is re-opened by Bevis Bulmer.

t: 新教联盟由新教德意志邦联而来,旨在捍卫每个成员的权利,土地和安全,对抗天主教会和天主教德意志邦.
te: The Protestant Union, a coalition of Protestant German states, is founded to defend the rights, land and safety of each…
dz: 新教联盟由新教德意志邦联而来,旨在捍卫每个成员的权利,土地和安全,对抗天主教会和天主教德意志邦.
de: The Protestant Union, a coalition of Protestant German states, is founded to defend the rights, land and safety of each member against the Catholic Church and Catholic German states.

t: 弗吉尼亚殖民地获得一个特许地,将边界从"海"延伸至"海".
te: The Colony of Virginia gets a charter, extending borders from "sea to sea".
dz: 弗吉尼亚殖民地获得一个特许地,将边界从"海"延伸至"海".
de: The Colony of Virginia gets a charter, extending borders from "sea to sea".

t: 塞缪尔·德·钱普兰在第三次去新法兰西的旅程中 在魁北克的塔都萨克登陆,并开始建立防御工事.
te: Samuel de Champlain lands at Tadoussac, Quebec, in the course of his third voyage to New France, and begins erecting fo…
dz: 塞缪尔·德·钱普兰在第三次去新法兰西的旅程中 在魁北克的塔都萨克登陆,并开始建立防御工事.
de: Samuel de Champlain lands at Tadoussac, Quebec, in the course of his third voyage to New France, and begins erecting fortifications.

t: 魁北克市由塞缪尔·德·尚普兰(Samuel de Champlain)创立.
te: Québec City is founded by Samuel de Champlain.
dz: 魁北克市由塞缪尔·德·尚普兰(Samuel de Champlain)创立.
de: Québec City is founded by Samuel de Champlain.

t: 英国驻印度的首位官方代表登陆苏拉特.
te: The first official English representative to India lands in Surat.
dz: 英国驻印度的首位官方代表登陆苏拉特.
de: The first official English representative to India lands in Surat.

t: 约翰·史密斯被选为弗吉尼亚州詹姆斯敦的议会主席.
te: John Smith is elected council president of Jamestown, Virginia.
dz: 约翰·史密斯被选为弗吉尼亚州詹姆斯敦的议会主席.
de: John Smith is elected council president of Jamestown, Virginia.
